provenance.summary: Demonstrably-existing RE tool seed, NOT a reconstruction of 147 enumerated rows.
provenance.note: wq#3908 asked to 'save' a tool-catalog.json (147 tools, 9 categories) said to have been created in an earlier design session but never written to disk. The landed architecture decision wq#3806 (design/wq3806_limpet_architecture.md:32-38) already verified that /home/lumen/projects/limpet/ contained only VISION.md and that the '147 tools' figure is a target, not an enumerated input; it explicitly refused to fabricate 147 rows. No DESIGN-DECISIONS.md or 'Universal Hardware RE Tool Catalog research' exists in the repo or any granted directory. This catalog therefore follows wq#3806 section 1.3: seed from the RE surface that demonstrably exists, each entry at the correct trust tier, so the '147' target becomes an auditable outcome of promotion rather than a fabricated claim.
sources: TOOL_REGISTRY.md (Maksoor RE workstation verified inventory, wq#3803, 2026-10-14)
limpet/examples/*.toml (plugin manifests: upstream URLs, summaries, licenses, wq#3884)
provenance.caveat: Verified paths/versions reflect the Maksoor RE workstation (the reference RE host, verified 2026-10-14), the seed for the Limpet appliance image; they are not re-verified on a dedicated Limpet node, which does not yet exist. Tools with path=null are catalogued for visibility but are not yet runnable-resolved; import_catalog.py skips them by design rather than guessing a path.
provenance.trust_tiers: core = proven on fleet, in base image; vetted = passed TOOL_REGISTRY go/no-go; community = present/known but disabled until human promotion (includes HOLD and NO-GO evaluations).
provenance.reconciliation: wq#3936 (2026-10-15): reconciled the 34 wq#3908-verified rows with all reachable on-disk sources and added install_method/mcp_status/disk_size_estimate/priority. New rows (8): searchsploit, component-id, fw-diff, gepetto, pyamlboot, sunxi-fel, fiedka, glitchkit. searchsploit/component-id/fw-diff from on-disk manifests; gepetto/pyamlboot/sunxi-fel from on-disk research/design docs; fiedka/glitchkit are ticket-named promotion stubs (no verifiable on-disk source, web-verify unavailable per wq#2595) carried at trust=community with url=null rather than fabricated. Sources named by the ticket that are NOT on disk and were therefore not folded in: docs/tool-registry-spec.md, DESIGN-DECISIONS.md, VISION.md and install-wizard-spec.md (the real limpet VISION.md lives in /home/lumen/projects/limpet/, outside this worktree; see design/wq3806_limpet_architecture.md:32-45). Farida Phase 2 signed skills (11 tools) are on a remote node with no manifest reachable from this worktree, so not enumerated here.
provenance.field_methodology: mcp_status=has_server only where an MCP server file exists on disk (wq#3881/3882/3883 server.py, wq#3942 server.py, rea/ghidra-mcp bridges); else cli_only. install_method is a best-known static class; the authoritative apt/pip/cargo resolution is dpkg -S at ISO build (limpet/iso-builder/gen_tool_packages.py). disk_size_estimate is a coarse planning bucket (small<100MB / medium 100MB-1GB / large>1GB), not a per-host measurement; null where unmeasured. priority maps from trust: core->core, vetted->recommended, community->optional.
provenance.license_risk_policy: wq#3959 (design/wq3959_license_audit_oghidra_emba_fact_fat.md): the free-text 'license' field alone is not enough to catch redistribution risk (a GPL-3.0 tool and a Functional-Source/Business-Source/custom-EULA tool can both look like a short license string, but only one of them blocks bundling into the commercially-sold Limpet ISO). Every tool entry going forward MUST also carry 'license_risk' (none | copyleft-source-offer | non-osi-commercial-restricted | unverified) and 'redistribution_posture' (bundle | external-invoke | blocked-pending-permission). Any non-OSI / source-available license with a commercial-use or 'competing use' carve-out (FSL, BSL, custom written-permission clauses) gets license_risk=non-osi-commercial-restricted and redistribution_posture=external-invoke (or blocked-pending-permission if the integration plan assumes bundling) until a written commercial license or legal sign-off is obtained — that sign-off is the one legitimate human-gated step here, everything else (scoping the integration to external-invoke) is applied without waiting on it. See the ghidra entry below for the fields in practice, and the audit doc for EMBA/FACT (GPL-3.0, safe to bundle with a source offer)/FAT 2.0 (FSL-1.1-ALv2, external-invoke only)/OGhidra (unverified, treat as external-invoke only) ahead of their wq#3929 P0 adoption.
